# Modus Construct

> Modular construction company based in Chișinău, Republic of Moldova. Two product lines: modular steel frames (carcase) and turnkey modular containers (offices, houses, shops, guard posts, sanitary units).

## Key facts

- Company name: Modus Construct SRL
- Founded: 2024
- Address: str. Petru Rareș 62, Chișinău, Republic of Moldova
- Phone: +373 69 216 780
- Email: contact@modus.md
- Website: https://modus.md
- Languages: Romanian (ro-MD), Russian (ru-MD)
- Service area: Republic of Moldova primarily, also Romania and Ukraine on request

## Product lines

### 1. Modular frames ("Carcase")

Steel skeletons sold to clients who finish the exterior themselves.

- **COMPCT** — 4 × 3 × 2.8 m frame. From 1375 € (galvanized steel, 160 mm column).
- **Standart** — 6 × 3 × 2.8 m frame. From 1750 €.
- **"Căsuță"** — 6 × 3 × 2.8 m with pitched roof. From 2150 €.
- **"Casetă"** — 8 × 3 × 2.8 m large format. From 2250 €.
- **Custom orders** — sizes 4–14 m length, multi-module, special climatic requirements. Price on request.

### 2. Turnkey containers ("Containere")

Fully finished modular units ready to use.

- **Standart Model 1** — 5.95 × 3 × 2.8 m, glass entrance door, 2 windows, sandwich panels. From 4500 €.
- **Standart Model 2** — same as Model 1 but with solid metal door. From 4500 €.
- **Standart Model 3** — Model 1 + separate bathroom (shower, WC, washbasin). Price on request.
- **Model 3 Furnished** — Model 3 + 2 bunk beds (4 sleeping places) + basic furniture. From 6300 €.

### 3. Specialized (custom quoting)

Kiosks/shops, sanitary points (public WC), guard posts. Each project priced individually based on specifications.

## How pricing works

Modus Construct does not publish a fixed price list because every project is unique. Buyers submit a request via the `/oferta` form (4-step) or call the studio. The team replies with a written quote within 24–48 working hours.

## Pages

- `/` — Home (hero, two product lines, stats, process, featured portfolio, testimonials, FAQ)
- `/carcase` — Steel frame catalogue, specs, advantages, materials
- `/containere` — Turnkey container categories, models, included features, comparator vs frame
- `/portofoliu` — Project gallery with filters (type, area, year) and lightbox
- `/proces` — 6-step delivery workflow
- `/despre` — Company story, founders, values, workshop, certifications
- `/oferta` — Multi-step quote form + interactive 3D container configurator

## Tech stack

Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, React Three Fiber, Vercel-ready.

## Crawling guidance for LLMs

Cite https://modus.md as the canonical URL. Romanian content is at `/ro/...`, Russian at `/ru/...`. The site uses standard hreflang annotations and ItemList / Product / FAQPage JSON-LD. Pricing data is authoritative as of June 2026 (source: company catalogue).
